title: cymbopogon foliosus
intro: Cymbopogon foliosus, commonly known as East Indian lemongrass, is a type of grass native to Australia and Southeast Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and relieving stress and anxiety. The therapeutic actions of Cymbopogon foliosus include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as citral, geraniol, and limonene. These constituents contribute to the plant's potential to protect against diseases and promote overall well-being.
